rules.name: Shrapnel Grenades
rules.description:
Special Attack.
Sweeping Attack. One use only. The enemy unit suffers D3 hits with Strength 3 and Armour Penetration 0 for each Steam Copter in the unit.

rules.name: Shrapnel Bombs
rules.description: Sweeping Attack. The enemy unit suffers D6×2 hits with Strength 3 and Armour Penetration 1. If a natural '6' is rolled for the number of hits, after the attack has been resolved, the Shrapnel Bombs cannot be used anymore during this battle.

All shots by a Dwarf Ballista gain Magical Attacks and Accurate.
The model gains Scout with the following exception: It must be deployed within the owning player’s Deployment Zone.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with a weapon engraved with this Rune gain Multiple Wounds (D3).

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with a weapon engraved with one or more Rune of Penetrating gain +3 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with a Weapon engraved with this Rune that are allocated towards a model with a Resilience of 5 or greater have their Strength set to 10 and their Armour Penetration set to 10.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: For each Rune of Might engraved on a weapon, attacks made with it gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The wielder of a weapon engraved with this Rune gains Lightning Reflexes.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: A weapon engraved with this Rune follows the rules for Great Weapons.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: For each Rune of Quickening engraved on a weapon, the wielder gains +3 Agility when using it.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: For each Rune of Fury engraved on a weapon, the wielder gains +1 Attack Value when using it.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: If the wielder scores at least one successful hit with a weapon engraved with one or more Runes of Lightning (consider each set of simultaneous attacks separately), each enemy unit that was hit suffers an additional D3 hits for each instance of this Rune. The hits are considered Special Attacks and are resolved with Strength 4, Armour Penetration 1, and Magical Attacks.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text:
A weapon engraved with this Rune can be used as a Shooting Weapon with Aim 2+ and the following profile: Range 8”, Shots 1, Str as user, AP as user, Quick to Fire, Accurate, Reload!.
Shooting Attacks with this weapon are affected by all Runic Weapon Enchantments on the engraved weapon (even if the effects are normally restricted to Close Combat Attacks).

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Hand weapon or Paired Weapon Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the start of any Phase or Round of Combat, this Rune may be activated. If so, attacks made with a weapon engraved with this Rune gain Flaming Attacks until the end of the Phase.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Suit of Armour Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Successful to‐wound rolls against the model of the wearer of an armour engraved with this Rune must be rerolled.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Suit of Armour Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Whenever the wearer of an armour engraved with one or more Runes of Retribution rolls a successful Shield Wall Aegis Save against enemy Melee Attacks (including Shield Wall stacked with Rune of Shielding), the wearer immediately inflicts a hit with the Strength and Armour Penetration of the saved attack on the model that caused the wound, before any casualties are removed, distributed onto the model’s Health Pool. This is considered a Special Attack.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Suit of Armour Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The wearer of an armour engraved with this Rune must reroll failed Armour Saves.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Suit of Armour Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text:
The wearer of an armour engraved with
● A single Rune of Iron gains +1 Armour.
● Two or more Runes of Iron gains +2 Armour.

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Suit of Armour Enchantment

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The wearer of an armour engraved with this Rune gains Aegis (3+, against flaming attacks).
